'''Chapter 570''' is titled "The Bridge of Life".

==Cover Page==
[[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] and Animals: [[Sanji]] is shooting a gun at a target, and a fish makes a hole in the target by spitting water powerfully at it.

==Short Summary==
After [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s burst of [[Haki]], [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] orders his men to back him up. As Luffy nears the platform, [[Boa Hancock|Hancock]] fights the [[Pacifista]] and encounters [[Sentomaru]], [[Crocodile]] clashes with [[Dracule Mihawk|Mihawk]], and [[Inazuma]] appears to create a path to the execution platform for Luffy. However, [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] steps in and states that Luffy must defeat him in order to reach [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]].

==Long Summary==
As everyone tries to recover from Luffy's massive burst of [[Haki]], Whitebeard's allies and the Marines alike all stand in awe of his power. Vice Admiral [[Doberman]] warns the Marines that Luffy has to be cut down, or else he will become a fearsome force in the future. When Ivankov asks Luffy how he got that level of power of Haki, Luffy responds that he has no idea what Ivankov is talking about. Ivankov lets Luffy be, but understands that even if Luffy does not realize it, he attracts people because of the will to fight the unknown, the same as [[Monkey D. Dragon|Dragon]].

The Marines convene around Whitebeard once more, who again brushes them aside. He then commands all of his forces to back up Luffy. Whitebeard thinks to himself that he wants Luffy to show him just what will come at the end of the Great Age of Pirates. As Luffy is about to be attacked, Whitebeard's allies jump in and protect him, telling him that he has to go on ahead while Whitebeard holds the Marines off. Ivankov tells Luffy that Whitebeard is putting all of his faith in him; Luffy responds that he does not care about Whitebeard, and that he's only there to save Ace. Mihawk attempts to attack Luffy, but is stopped by [[Daz Bonez|Mr. 1]], who responds to Luffy's shock by saying that he is protecting him only by Crocodile's orders. After Mihawk strikes Mr. 1 down, Crocodile interferes and protects his right-hand man.

[[Sentomaru]] yells at [[Boa Hancock|Hancock]] for stopping a great number of Pacifista, asking why she is doing it if she is on their side. She responds by shrieking that "love is always a hurricane" and leaves Sentomaru very confused.

Ivankov asks for help within his hair, and none other than [[Inazuma]], fully recovered, answers to his call. He leaps from Ivankov's hair and, cutting up the ground around him, makes a walkway that leads to the execution platform. Thanking Inazuma, Luffy runs up towards Ace. Many of the Marines try to stop Luffy, but they are halted by Whitebeard and his forces. Whitebeard's allies, as well as Buggy and his crew, watch Luffy get closer and closer to Ace; however, [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] leaps through the bridge from below, landing between Luffy and Ace, cracking the ground with his impact. Luffy tells Garp to move aside, but Garp refuses, as he is a Marine Headquarters [[Vice Admiral]].

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*Both [[Shanks]] and [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] possess [[Haki/Supreme King Haki|Supreme King Haki]].
*It appears that Whitebeard has decided to put his faith in Luffy.
*Inazuma, who has been hiding in Ivankov's hair, is finally seen again.
*Inazuma creates a bridge to the execution platform, but Garp stands in Luffy's way.
